description: Harvard’s Center for Green Buildings and Cities publishes two years of HouseZero building observations from 189 sensors. Hourly records cover June 2022 to May 2024 and include indoor air and slab temperatures, humidity, carbon dioxide, weather, thermal-system loads, window states and valve conditions. The Figshare deposit lists 22 CSV files and a data-report document, freely available under CC BY 4.0. These observations can calibrate building-physics and control simulations in model-energyplus, including interactions between natural ventilation and thermal operation. A caveat is that HouseZero is a specific experimental office building, so its schedules and systems should not be transferred directly to ordinary building stock. Sensor filtering and gap treatment affect validation. The file inventory and documentation metadata were checked; no CSV values or report PDF were downloaded.
